thread:
amanda_sales: Quick ask — customer (FinTech) returned a SIG/CAIQ with a focused BCP/DR section. They want explicit RTO/RPO, backup cadence, failover approach, and SLA differences between Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Also asking if a POC demonstrating failover is possible and whether higher SLAs change pricing. Can we draft answers and next steps? /cc @sam_security @raj_engineering

sam_security: Happy to. High level first: RTO/RPO and guarantees vary by deployment: Hosted = best-effort HA with platform-level mitigations; Dedicated = SLA-backed (region-level redundancy); Private = customer-controlled but we provide tooling + runbooks.

raj_engineering: Adding some concrete numbers we typically use in presales: Hosted (multi-tenant): target uptime 99.9%, RTO ~ 30-60m for control-plane/service degradation, RPO best-effort (we retain request logs and checkpoints for up to 6 hrs depending on plan). Dedicated (reserved capacity): SLA 99.95% with automated regional failover option, RTO target 5-15m for worker replacement within cluster, RPO <= 1-5m with cross-zone replication. Private: depends on topology — with cross-region DR patterns we can architect RTO ~<15m, RPO configurable to minutes with replication.

olivia_sol_eng: For SIG/CAIQ wording we should be conservative and avoid committing client-side retention guarantees we can't control. Suggest language that maps to deployment tiers and references runbooks + SOC/compliance docs.

sam_security: Agreed. Draft suggested answer below (feel free to copy):

```
Suggested SIG response:
- RTO/RPO: Redwood provides deployment-tiered recovery objectives. For Hosted API we target an RTO of 30–60 minutes and operate with a 99.9% availability target. For Dedicated customers we offer an SLA-backed 99.95% availability with optional cross-region failover; typical Dedicated RTO is 5–15 minutes and RPO is 1–5 minutes when cross-zone replication is enabled. For Private deployments, recovery objectives are defined in the customer-specific runbook and can achieve RTO < 15 minutes and RPO measured in minutes when configured for synchronous replication.
- Backups: Model artifacts and configuration snapshots are taken regularly (configurable; default snapshot cadence: 6 hours) and retained per customer retention policy. Customer data persistence and backup policies vary by deployment and are documented in the Private/Dedicated runbook.
- Failover: We provide automated worker replacement, zone-aware scheduling, and optional cross-region DNS failover for Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted, we maintain multi-zone capacity and automatic routing fallbacks to compatible model variants.
- SLA & Pricing: SLA-backed Dedicated offerings and cross-region replication are billable features. Pricing differentials are provided during quoting.
```

amanda_sales: This is great — can you add one sentence on encryption/KMS and runbook access? They asked about control plane vs customer-managed keys.

sam_security: Add: "All deployments support at-rest encryption; Hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default with a customer KMS option for Dedicated and Private. Audit logs and runbooks are shared under NDA for enterprise customers."

raj_engineering: Also note technical detail: live KV caches are best-effort (not a durable backup); for stateful workloads we recommend explicit checkpointing to persistent stores (S3/Blob) with our connectors. I'll paste a snippet to include.

olivia_sol_eng: I'll coordinate the POC. Proposed scope: 1) provision Dedicated cluster in staging, 2) enable cross-zone replication, 3) run simulated regional failover, 4) capture RTO/RPO metrics and logs. Need customer signoff for test window and budget for 24-48h reserved capacity. Suggested dates: week of 04/06.

amanda_sales: Customer ok with week of 04/06. Pricing note — Raj, can you estimate uplift for cross-region replication + SLA? I should flag to procurement.

raj_engineering: Ballpark: Dedicated base commit + SLA ~ +12–18% on top of baseline. Cross-region replication / reserved DR nodes ~ additional 20–30% depending on capacity. I'll produce a short quote matrix for Olivia to include in the POC doc.

olivia_sol_eng: Action items:
- Olivia: send POC plan and sign-up link to customer (today)
- Raj: quote matrix for SLA/replication (by EOD)
- Sam: final SIG/CAIQ phrasing + KMS sentence (by EOD)
- Amanda: confirm contract clause language for runbook/NDA

amanda_sales: Thanks all. If we get the SIG answers approved I’ll attach them to the RAR and move to legal review. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: provision-request accepted — Dedicated staging cluster scheduled for 2026-04-06 09:00 UTC (id: dr-poctest-004).

sam_security: Leaving one caution in the SIG language: avoid absolute RTO/RPO promises for Hosted. Use ranges and reference "target" and "typical" phrasing.

amanda_sales: Noted — final draft will use "target" wording. I'll post the approved SIG response back here once legal signs off.
